newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends down on local selling, CBOT soy.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends down on local selling, CBOT soy.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended down on local selling and lower CBOT soycomplex values.

"Locals sold following Chicago, commercials were mixed and there was a lack of closing hedges," a trader said. November WCE canola crush profit margins fell to -7.79 Monday from -6.77 Friday. Aug-Sep spread at $10, Mar-May $4. Volume was 1,200 lots, or 24,000 tonnes, with 250 hedge lots.

August canola lost $3.20 to $350.50, November down $3.10 to $341.60. September flax fell $0.90 to $282.60, November lost $3.50 to $279.50 as LFG and Midland Walwyn sold and January fell $2.50 to $282.50 on local selling. Sep-Nov $4.
October western barley lost $2.40 to $126 on commission and hedge selling, December fell $2.30 to $127.20 with commercials, locals and western feedlots buying. Volume 525.
October feed wheat lost $0.70 to $152, December down $1.50 to $152 on light hedges, local buying and two-way commission house trade. July-Oct spread at $3.50. Volume was 377 lots.
Commercials traded 10 October oats, down US$1.50 to US$107. Feed peas did not trade.
(All values in Canadian dollars except oats.)
